Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the text and PRIDE metadata is a proof-of-concept characterization of the ExtraPEG method using a single cell line (HeLa). It is not a differential proteomics study comparing different biological conditions, treatments, or genotypes; rather, it is a method-validation study to identify the proteome of isolated vesicles. Therefore, it is mapped as 'un-classified'.

MStype_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the enrichment of extracellular vesicles (exosomes) using a PEG-based method. While phosphorylation was listed as a dynamic modification in the PRIDE metadata, there is no evidence of a specific phospho-enrichment workflow (e.g., TiO2/IMAC), so mod_phospho is not selected as a modifier. The acquisition is DDA based on the use of Sequest HT/Mascot and the instrument type (LTQ Orbitrap Velos) in a shotgun proteomics context.
